decisions.statement: A leaf is written as one line.
A leaf line holds the path to that leaf.
A leaf line has the type of that leaf.
A leaf line has the value of that leaf.
A table is walked in TypeScript by one set of rules.
A table is walked in Lua by the same rules.
A table's number keys are walked ahead of that table's word keys.
A table's number keys are walked in number order.
A number is written by the rule Lua writes that number by.
Two dumps are told apart leaf by leaf rather than by a digest.
Every leaf of the upstream dump is walked in path order.
Every leaf of the ported dump is walked in path order.
A leaf the upstream dump alone has is named as upstream's own.
A leaf the ported dump alone has is named as the port's own.
A leaf whose value differs is named apart from a leaf one dump alone carries.
An agreement says how many leaves agreed.
Nothing here writes to a stream.

definition: a nested table written out as one line per leaf, and the reading telling two apart
